_rules: B-152 (D-176): a timing check listed here is advisory. It reports its numbers, re-runs once in place on a miss, and fails the harness only on a second miss in a row. Each returns to blocking after 20 green scheduled nightlies since its date: node tools/chart.mjs quarantine --runs <the saved nightly run list> names the ones due; returning one is taking its row out of this file.

captions-history-pull.what: the captions history pull block (D-128): pulls past today under date dividers, its waits timed

captions-pace.what: the D-137 reveal pace: first sentence at speech pace, the reply within 6 s, speech ending with the last word

core-frame-budget.what: the core's frame budget at 4x CPU, DPR 3 (D-135): slow-frame share, the core's own draw p95, no step-down

core-step-down.what: the run-time step-down under a 40x throttle (D-135): wisps off, then half the points
